The desk manages human action and payment authorization. Explain architectural fit through each layer's responsibilities and integration contracts. Organization context and records run across the composition, keeping product, operations, and governance connected.
integracao.text02: Integration starts with a defined contract.
integracao.text03: The receivables API connects offers, simulation, proposals, and tracking to your channel. The console SDK integrates leads, workflows, and agents through APIs to shape your institution's experience.
integracao.text12: Leads, workflows, and agents through APIs.
integracao.notes: Presentation paths: 40 · 60. Present integration through the contract between the customer experience and the credit platform. For receivables, the API brings together offers, items, simulation, assessment, proposals, acceptance, and signing; for loans, the desk and web assistant manage the journey. Explain system communication through this API and the data and action responsibilities at each step. The app consumes the catalog and presents the corresponding experience, while the platform manages the credit domain. The console SDK exposes leads, workflows, and agents through APIs.
composicao.text02: Every component has a clear responsibility.
composicao.text03: IAM, individual, and business records establish identity. BaaS accounts and payments move funds; calculations, Decision, signing, documents, and audit trails bring credit operations together in installable packages.
composicao.notes: Presentation paths: 40 · 60. Show composition through each component's product responsibility. Calculations organize terms; Decision applies policies; signing executes documents; audit trails record transactions. Building blocks add identity, individuals, businesses, accounts, payments, collections, biometrics, extraction, and communication. Explain reuse through these independent responsibilities and packages that combine product, policy, and workflows. The institution configures its portfolio on a shared foundation, retaining its brand and its organization's data, keys, and events. The installable vertical combines products, policy, workflows, accounts, and keys; the console SDK and institution-owned gateway appear on the integration and collection slides.
hospedagem.text06: Deploy in your environment, aligned with your infrastructure requirements.
hospedagem.text10: Delivered as a service, with operational responsibilities defined in your agreement.
hospedagem.text11: THE SAME PRODUCT JOURNEY IN BOTH MODELS
hospedagem.notes: Presentation paths: 20 · 40 · 60. Give both models equal weight. On-premises delivers the platform in the customer's environment, aligned with its infrastructure requirements. SaaS delivers the platform as a service, with operational responsibilities defined in the agreement. Explain control through the chosen model and the allocation of infrastructure, data, access, updates, and support. Catalisa operates its own infrastructure with versioned releases. Hosting is part of the commercial and technical partnership, retaining the white-label product and each institution's context in both models.
por-que.text02: The foundation for your next product.
por-que.text04: Your customers get clear terms and a path to contracting.
por-que.text06: Your team gets execution tools and a credit desk to manage lending.
por-que.text08: Your risk team reviews policy and records to assess each transaction.
por-que.notes: Presentation paths: 60. Explain the investment through what the institution can offer and operate with the platform. Catalisa combines a contracting experience, a shared decision engine, the desk, execution and documentation, servicing, and collections. The partnership's value lies in combining this foundation with the buyer's understanding of its audience, distribution, and risk. Explain platform value through product continuity: customers understand and contract, teams manage the transaction, and the portfolio stays under active oversight. The institution's brand anchors the relationship, with composition and hosting aligned to its strategy.
posicao.text07: Credit and banking, decisioning and operations, conversation and workflows come together in your product. The platform combines these foundations with your institution's expertise and distribution.
posicao.notes: Presentation paths: 60. Use the map to explain the partnership's positioning. Banking and credit shape the offerings; Decision and the desk organize criteria and human action; conversation and workflows support service and operational continuity. Explain differentiation through the combination of these capabilities around the institution's customer. One journey makes product, risk, and operational responsibilities visible. The buyer contributes audience expertise and distribution, while the platform provides the foundation for configuring and managing the portfolio under its brand.
associacao.text04: Expand your portfolio under your brand. Usage-based pricing and success fees are commercial options; acquisition of the platform or the company can also be part of the discussion.
associacao.notes: Presentation paths: 20 · 40 · 60. Lead with a partnership that brings the offering to customers under the buyer's brand. The commercial structure can follow usage or a success fee, with jointly defined criteria; acquisition is also an option. Negotiations cover scope, responsibilities, knowledge, and rights. In its September 29, 2026 release on agentic AI built through vendor forward-deployed engineering, Gartner recommends defining "deliverables, knowledge transfer, intellectual property rights and transition or exit responsibilities" in the contract. This reference helps structure the agreement; partnership terms will reflect the buyer's strategy. Source: Gartner, September 29, 2026 release on agentic projects built through forward-deployed engineering, section "Phase 1: Before Signing". Official release: https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2026-09-29-gartner-predicts-70-percent-of-enterprises-will-abandon-agentic-ai-built-by-vendor-forward-deployed-engineering-by-2028.
reutilizar.text02: Build your next offering on a shared foundation.
reutilizar.text03: Gartner: "Modular, specialized agents can boost efficiency, speed up delivery, and reduce risk by reusing proven solutions across workflows". Our view: make reuse a foundation for portfolio growth.
reutilizar.text04: GARTNER · TOP STRATEGIC TECHNOLOGY TRENDS FOR 2026 · OCTOBER 20, 2025
reutilizar.notes: Presentation paths: 60. Use Gartner's verified wording: "Modular, specialized agents can boost efficiency, speed up delivery, and reduce risk by reusing proven solutions across workflows". Explain the connection to the portfolio through Catalisa's strategic view: compose offerings from reusable capabilities. Attribute that interpretation to Catalisa; the source supports the reuse argument. In the platform, building blocks and vertical packages make this foundation concrete, combining calculations, decisioning, communication, and operations to meet different needs under the institution's brand. Source: Gartner, Top Strategic Technology Trends for 2026, October 20, 2025, section "Multiagent Systems". Official release: https://www.gartner.com/en/newsroom/press-releases/2025-10-20-gartner-identifies-the-top-strategic-technology-trends-for-2026.

proximo-passo.text06: Review execution, the desk, and records.

proximo-passo.text08: Define the product, integration, and partnership model.
proximo-passo.notes: Presentation paths: 20 · 40 · 60. Close with a concrete product choice. The buyer selects the audience and offering, explores the customer experience, and reviews decisioning, desk operations, execution, and servicing. Explain the way forward through scope decisions: product, parameters, channels, integration responsibilities, hosting, and commercial model. One journey makes these choices tangible for product, risk, operations, and architecture teams. End with a shared view of what the institution wants to offer under its brand and how it intends to manage that relationship.
fecho.text03: Your customers understand the offer; your team manages credit and reviews the transaction history. Catalisa brings it together under your brand, delivered on-premises in your environment or as SaaS.
fecho.notes: Presentation paths: 20 · 40 · 60. Return to the proposition from the institution's and customer's perspectives. The offer presents clear terms, the team manages credit, and the portfolio remains under active oversight. Decision provides the shared foundation for decisions, while channels, the desk, security, and configuration support operations. Close with what the institution brings to its customers: a product under its own brand, supported by the Catalisa platform. Give on-premises and SaaS equal emphasis, then conclude with the journey and partnership that best serve the buyer's strategy.
